pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with diffuse pixel gradients at the edges; spatial area varies from large, elongated shapes on the upper neck to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming a network of variable pixel thickness; junction nodes are visible as tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections of the pathways separating patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the superior neck line, representing the mane contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct area of textural disruption and reduced contrast is visible on the upper shoulder/lower neck junction where the typical patch-corridor distinction is blurred.
